result.question: How did Uzziah follow his father Amaziah’s example?

readings.answer: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
readings.support: he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done

assessments.reason: 2 Chronicles 26:4 states, “he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done,” matching the answer exactly.

result.reason: Verse 26:4 directly says Uzziah did what was right in the LORD’s eyes as Amaziah had done.
